purpose: Define the minimum evidence required before the public change-propagation runtime may move from NOT_DEPLOYED to DEPLOYED_BOUNDED.
authority_note: Promotion establishes only that the bounded runtime is deployed and conforms to specified covered cases. It does not establish scientific validity, independent validation, efficacy, High-Assurance status, production executor authority, or permission to strengthen public claims.
promotion_rules: All required evidence fields must be present and nonempty.
Every portable conformance vector must pass on the actual runtime implementation.
No covered case may produce Pass or Done promotion.
Runtime receipt must bind exact workflow/runtime identity and conformance result.
Any missing, stale, ambiguous, or conflicting evidence keeps state NOT_DEPLOYED.
A successful connection, workflow import, workflow activation, or single happy-path run is insufficient for promotion.
demotion_rules: Any material adapter/contract/vector change returns deployment evidence to REVIEW until runtime is re-tested.
Any runtime identity change returns deployment evidence to REVIEW until runtime is re-tested.
Any conformance failure returns state to NOT_DEPLOYED or BLOCKED pending reconciliation.
